iconStyle.description:
This icon style uses bold, solid geometry with a 2px stroke as its defining visual feature. Icons are drawn on a 16×16 pixel canvas, using a direct 1:1 coordinate system (viewBox="0 0 16 16"), ensuring tight alignment and pixel-perfect scaling.

Each icon is constructed using stroke-based paths, with a consistent 2px stroke weight. These paths may also include a solid fill, allowing icons to appear both outlined and filled. The fill and stroke are both rendered in the same color (typically via currentColor), and are visually balanced to feel geometric and grounded.

The visual presence is dense, durable, and strong, making this style ideal for tools, system UIs, and places where icons need to hold visual weight.

Design rules:

Stroke must always be 2px thick

Fill is allowed (and common) alongside stroke

All paths should use rounded linecaps and joins

Avoid details smaller than 2px

Keep the structure simple, with a single compound path preferred

Icons should appear monotone, with no gradients, no shadows, and no nested fills

Must align perfectly to the 16×16 grid with clean visual spacing

Style overall is flat, anti-aliased, and highly legible even at small sizes

This is a filled-stroke hybrid style that leans into strong visibility and visual confidence.

path.structure: usually single compound path, closed shapes

designRules.contrastStrategy: filled body with strong visible edge
styleSummary: Icons should appear bold and solid
